ruling: WLD-116 (Darko, 2026-10-23 13:47-13:50): the machinery buildings, their function pointers and the code registry retire now; nothing reads them. Classes are law nodes, never marks (the law tree, WORLD/law/).
why: The Great Convergence (2026-08-01) filed one building per piece of code, each citing the code that keeps it true. No code in any repo reads `mechanic_draft:` or the registry, and the arrow points the wrong way (code points at law nodes, never the reverse). Observability is its own track: canon is served by the doors (explain: and a LOGOS read), and later an embodied library, derived and regenerated, one writer.

kept.the-town/the-keeping-works: the seat, a plain landmark (its body no longer claims the buildings); it will hold the library
kept.noe/say-which-copy: Noe's predicate on the relay office, re-parented to the seat (id unchanged); Wright writes Noe a letter
